skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Ignis Fatuus
skins.content: 0011 Tempest Series New Arrivals/Ignis Fatuus. A gift for Lessing from some young Liches, for taking the brunt of their teacher's ire. Though it's the opposite of his usual style, he looks surprisingly cool in it.
skins.quote: Lessing hasn't said what he thinks of this outfit, and some suspect that trying a new style might be a form of 'training under pressure' for him. He's been wearing it for a few days now, though. He has to like them, right?
